formulas.formula: Dark mode. Bright goals. Watch your money grow.
1. Setup: your name and the year.
2. Goals: what you're saving for, the target, the date, and what you plan to save each month.
3. Deposits: every time you add money (or take some out, as a minus), log it here.
4. Goals shows if you're on track, how much you need per month, and when you'll finish at your pace.
5. Growth Calculator: see what steady saving plus interest can grow into.
6. Dashboard and Monthly: your savings at a glance.
Set up automatic transfers on payday. Saving becomes the default.
A higher APY makes your money grow faster. Add your APY on Goals.
Took money out? Log it as a negative amount, like -200.
Break big goals into milestones. Every 10% is worth celebrating.
Clear the lighter cells on Goals and Deposits, then update Setup.
Dark cells: these calculate for you.
Amber: almost there, or worth a look.
Red: behind, or something to check.
Saved = starting amount + your deposits. Projected Finish uses your monthly plan and APY.
Money in (positive) or out (negative, like -200). Pick the goal from the list.
Deposits and withdrawals by month. Total Saved = all goals' starting amounts plus everything logged up to that month.
What if? Steady monthly saving plus interest, compounded monthly.
